items.headline: Fortune: the Fed doesn't know who's financing the $3 trillion AI boom
items.note: Commentary flags that leverage and counterparty links across the private-credit vehicles funding AI buildouts are poorly understood by regulators, echoing pre-2008 opacity concerns — notable color, not a realized event.

items.headline: SoftBank finalizes record ¥1tn ($6.3B) retail bond to fund AI/OpenAI commitments, pricing Sept 4
items.note: Terms set (7-year notes, 4.3-4.9% indicative coupon) for the largest-ever Japanese corporate retail bond, underscoring SoftBank's growing reliance on debt — including retail investors — to fund its AI/OpenAI exposure.

items.headline: AI-driven bond issuance pushes borrowing costs higher economy-wide; 30-year Treasury hits 19-year high
items.note: Corporate bond issuance up 27% YTD to $1.7T with the 30-year Treasury at 5.32% (Aug 18) and PJM capacity prices up ~6x YoY — concrete evidence that AI-infra debt supply is now repricing the broader cost of capital, tightening conditions for every leveraged AI-adjacent borrower.
